integrity: Original algorithm is attributed to Orvieto--Xiao. Published one-step model-index comparisons are prior art. The proven contribution is a sharp multi-step dynamical threshold and local attracting cycle; exact-rational checks supplement the proof.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic one-dimensional positive-floor quadratics and a fixed parameter only. No global supercritical basin or uniqueness of non-antipodal cycles is claimed; no stochastic or high-dimensional assertion.
title: A sharp loss-floor flip and an attracting two-cycle for nonnegative Gauss--Newton descent
